area.description: what to read; the network areas (credentials, jump_servers, proxies, schedules, cloud_setups, locations, tag_definitions, custom_command_groups) need network_id, the others take none

view.description: collection_settings: every setting with Forward's default, set or default, and whether it differs, for the organization and each collector; custom_command_groups: the groups that apply to the one device named in name

x-values.effective: collection_settings: every setting against its default for the organization and each collector; custom_command_groups: the groups that apply to the device in name

org_id.description: org_properties, and licensing (another organization's stored licenses; Forward support, SaaS): the organization to read (default: the organization of network_id, else the only organization this login sees)

command.description: custom_command_groups only: keep the groups whose commands contain this text (ignoring case)

name.description: a substring of the object's name
